source_title: Circus Circus Las Vegas Treats Families to Half-Price Midway Games and Adventuredome Wristbands This Halloween
source_excerpt:
Halloween festivities include discounted games, thrilling rides and trick-or-treating throughout the iconic Las Vegas Strip resort on October 31
LAS VEGAS , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Circus Circus Las Vegas , the iconic Las Vegas Strip resort and the city's premier family-friendly destination for nearly 60 years, is celebrating Halloween with an afternoon of family-friendly fun, offering half-price Midway games and Adventuredome wristbands , along with trick-or-treating opportunities throughout both attractions on Saturday, October 31.
From noon to 3 p.m., families can enjoy special Halloween savings at two of the resort's most iconic attractions, giving locals and visitors alike an affordable way to celebrate the holiday with carnival games, thrilling rides and sweet treats.
"There's something special about celebrating Halloween at Circus Circus," said Shana Gerety, general manager at Circus Circus Las Vegas. "Families can come together to enjoy the classic games, rides and experiences that have made the property a favorite for generations and create those core memories that last a lifetime."
Available Saturday, October 31, from noon to 3 p.m., the Halloween promotions include:
Half-Price Midway Games: Guests can enjoy 50% off games at the iconic Midway, home to more than 200 arcade and carnival games. Trick-or-treating will also be available at participating games while candy supplies last.
Half-Price Adventuredome Wristbands: Families can experience the thrills of Las Vegas' only indoor theme park with 50% off Adventuredome wristbands. Guests can also trick-or-treat at participating rides while candy supplies last.
Spanning five acres beneath its signature pink glass dome, The Adventuredome offers an array of attractions for all ages, including Canyon Blaster, America's largest indoor double-loop, double-corkscrew roller coaster; El Loco, featuring a beyond-vertical drop; and SpongeBob's Crazy Carnival Ride, an immersive adventure through Bikini Bottom.
The Halloween festivities build on Circus Circus' longstanding commitment to delivering accessible family entertainment on the Las Vegas Strip. Beyond the holiday promotions, guests can enjoy free daily circus acts, complimentary parking and a variety of dining and entertainment options that continue to make the resort a destination for affordable, multigenerational fun.
For more information about Circus Circus Las Vegas and its attractions, visit www.circuscircus.com .
About Circus Circus Las Vegas Circus Circus Las Vegas, located at 2880 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109, is a privately owned hotel and casino that offers dining, shopping, entertainment and more than 101,000 square feet of gaming space. A family favorite Las Vegas resort since its inception, Circus Circus provides affordable rates for its nearly 4,000 guest rooms in its lodge, tower rooms, suites and RV Park, and family-fun activities ranging from the thrills of The Adventuredome theme park to live circus acts right on the casino floor.
For information visit www.circuscircus.com , or follow the property on Facebook , TikTok and Instagram .

hi_body:
सर्कस सर्कस लास वेगास ने शनिवार, 31 अक्टूबर 2026 को आयोजित होने वाले एक विशेष पारिवारिक हेलोवीन कार्यक्रम के दौरान आधे दाम पर मिड्वे गेम्स और एडवेंचरडोम रिस्टबैंड देने की योजना की घोषणा की है।

रिज़ॉर्ट की घोषणा के अनुसार, ये प्रमोशन छुट्टियों के दिन दोपहर 12 बजे से दोपहर 3 बजे तक चलेंगे। आगंतुकों को स्टॉक रहने तक भाग लेने वाले स्थानों पर ट्रिक-यार-ट्रीटिंग के अवसरों के साथ-साथ रियायती कार्निवल गेम और थीम पार्क की सुविधा मिल सकेगी।

## कार्यक्रम की मुख्य बातें
* **तारीख और समय:** शनिवार, 31 अक्टूबर 2026, दोपहर 12 बजे से दोपहर 3 बजे तक।
* **आधे दाम पर मिड्वे गेम्स:** मिड्वे में 200 से अधिक आर्केड और कार्निवल गेम्स पर 50% की छूट मिलेगी, साथ ही चुनिंदा गेम्स पर ट्रिक-यार-ट्रीटिंग उपलब्ध होगी।
* **आधे दाम पर एडवेंचरडोम रिस्टबैंड:** आगंतुक पाँच एकड़ में फैले इनडोर पिंक ग्लास डोम के भीतर राइड्स का आनंद लेने के लिए आधे दाम पर थीम पार्क रिस्टबैंड खरीद सकते हैं, जिसमें कैनियन ब्लास्टर रोलर कोस्टर, एल लोको और स्पॉन्जबॉब की क्रेज़ी कार्निवल राइड शामिल हैं।

## व्यावहारिक निहितार्थ और सत्यापन
लास वेगास स्ट्रिप रिज़ॉर्ट में दोपहर के उत्सव के लिए जाने की योजना बना रहे परिवारों को ध्यान देना चाहिए कि ट्रिक-यार-ट्रीटिंग कैंडी की आपूर्ति केवल स्टॉक रहने तक ही उपलब्ध है। महाप्रबंधक शाना गेरेटी ने उल्लेख किया कि इस कार्यक्रम का उद्देश्य संपत्ति के multigenerational फोकस के अनुरूप किफायती छुट्टियों का मनोरंजन प्रदान करना है।

कार्यक्रम के विवरण को सत्यापित करने, घंटों की पुष्टि करने या किसी भी शेड्यूल अपडेट की जाँच करने के लिए, इच्छुक व्यक्ति जाने से पहले www.circuscircus.com पर आधिकारिक सर्कस सर्कस लास वेगास वेबसाइट पर जा सकते हैं या फेसबुक, टिकटॉक और इंस्टाग्राम पर संपत्ति के आधिकारिक सोशल मीडिया चैनलों को देख सकते हैं।

en_body:
Circus Circus Las Vegas has announced plans to offer half-price Midway games and Adventuredome wristbands during a special family-friendly Halloween event scheduled for Saturday, October 31, 2026. 

According to the resort's announcement, the promotions will run from noon to 3 p.m. on the holiday. Visitors can access discounted carnival games and theme park access along with trick-or-treating opportunities at participating locations while supplies last.

## Event Highlights
* **Date and Time:** Saturday, October 31, 2026, from noon to 3 p.m.
* **Half-Price Midway Games:** A 50% discount will apply to games at the Midway, which features over 200 arcade and carnival options, alongside participating trick-or-treating.
* **Half-Price Adventuredome Wristbands:** Visitors can purchase theme park wristbands at half price to access rides inside the five-acre indoor pink glass dome, including the Canyon Blaster roller coaster, El Loco, and SpongeBob's Crazy Carnival Ride.

## Practical Implications and Verification
Families planning to visit the Las Vegas Strip resort for the afternoon festivities should note that trick-or-treating candy supplies are available only while stocks last. General manager Shana Gerety noted the event aims to provide affordable holiday entertainment consistent with the property's multigenerational focus. 

To verify event details, confirm hours, or check for any schedule updates, interested individuals can visit the official Circus Circus Las Vegas website at www.circuscircus.com or consult the property's official social media channels on Facebook, TikTok, and Instagram before attending.
